title: urldecode

gpu_support.notes: This text-only helper runs on the host. Numeric and provider-resident values are rejected before provider access.

description: `urldecode(text)` decodes percent-encoded URL text. It is a RunMat language extension for scripts that need URL text utilities.
behaviors: Accepts a string scalar or character row vector and returns decoded text.
Leaves ordinary characters unchanged and decodes valid percent-encoded bytes.
Numeric values, including native integer values, are not text and are rejected before provider access.
